description: This file contains functions and configuration snippets for managing Wi-Fi access points, including WPA/WPA2/WPA3 security, WPS, VLAN, and other network settings, primarily for hostapd and wpa_supplicant.

methods.name: hostapd_set_vlan_file
methods.description: Sets VLAN configuration for hostapd by appending VLAN info to a file and calling wireless_add_vlan.

methods.name: hostapd_set_vlan
methods.description: Removes existing VLAN config file and applies VLANs to interface.

methods.name: hostapd_set_psk_file
methods.description: Creates a file with MAC address to PSK mappings for hostapd.

methods.name: hostapd_set_sae_file
methods.description: Creates a file with MAC address to SAE key mappings for hostapd.

methods.name: hostapd_set_bss_options
methods.description: Configures BSS parameters for hostapd based on JSON input.

methods.name: hostapd_set_log_options
methods.description: Sets logging options for hostapd based on JSON input.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_teardown_interface
methods.description: Removes wpa_supplicant config and runtime files for an interface.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_prepare_interface
methods.description: Prepares wpa_supplicant config for an interface, including frequency and mode.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_set_fixed_freq
methods.description: Sets fixed frequency and channel width for wpa_supplicant network.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_add_network
methods.description: Adds a network configuration to wpa_supplicant with detailed parameters.
